seoPage.title: First-Time EV Buyer Guide for India — Calm, Step-by-Step | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: First-Time EV Buyer Guide for India — Calm, Step-by-Step — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: Buying your first EV should feel informed, not rushed. This guide orders the decisions — charging, budget, range, safety — and points to compare tools without hype.

editorialSections.title: Beginner confidence
paragraphs: Start with your parking and weekly km. Only then shortlist models — specs make more sense with your real pattern.

editorialSections.title: Step-by-step path
bullets: 1) Confirm charging (home, work, society, or public backup).
2) Set a realistic budget including install and insurance.
3) Shortlist two or three families, then compare variants.
4) Test drive for visibility, parking, and boot — not just 0–100 claims.

editorialSections.title: What not to overpromise yourself
paragraphs: No EV removes traffic, society paperwork, or monsoon planning. Savings on fuel can be real but vary — model with your tariff and km.

misconceptions.reality: Right-size range to avoid paying for unused kWh.
Parking and visibility matter as much as battery size.

faq.question: New vs used first EV?
faq.answer: New gives clearer warranty; used needs battery history — see used EV guide.

faq.question: How many models to compare?
faq.answer: Two or three families keep decisions calm.

faq.question: When to talk money?
faq.answer: After charging plan is clear — otherwise TCO guesses fail.

faq.question: Finance?
faq.answer: Treat like any car purchase — read total cost, not EMI alone.

faq.question: Ready to compare?
faq.answer: Open compare with your top two families side by side.
